'''Kim Katan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Decipher World Championship]] on 16 November 2001 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB]], according to Sean Vess's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3109">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-20-i-like-men-and-hobbits-va01-rightoned3109/ i-like-men-and-hobbits-va01-rightone], DeckTech (sean "Cyryn" vess, 20 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-20-i-like-men-and-hobbits-va01-rightoned3109/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
